glosses.attack: a unit of {0} on ({1} {2}) attacks the square ({3} {4})
glosses.check: the king of {0}, the side to move, is attacked
glosses.defended: a unit of {0} on ({1} {2}) is defended by another unit of {0}
glosses.hanging: a unit of {0} on ({1} {2}), not its king, is attacked and not defended
glosses.passed_pawn: the pawn of {0} on ({1} {2}) has no opposing pawn ahead of it on its own or an adjacent file
glosses.apart: a unit of {0} on ({1} {2}) and another unit of {3} on ({4} {5}) are {6} king-steps apart (one of the two is a king)
glosses.flight: the king of {0} could step to ({1} {2}): it is free of its own units and not attacked
glosses.opposition: the two kings face each other with exactly one square between them in a line
glosses.diagonal_opposition: the two kings face each other with exactly one square between them on a diagonal
glosses.to_promote: the pawn of {0} on ({1} {2}) is {3} forward steps from promoting
glosses.king_ahead: the king of {0} stands ahead of its own pawn on ({1} {2}), on its file or an adjacent one
glosses.in_square: the opposing king is inside the square of the pawn of {0} on ({1} {2}), near enough to catch it
glosses.key_gap: the king of {0} is {3} king-steps from the nearest key square of its own pawn on ({1} {2})
glosses.key_guard: the opposing king is {3} king-steps from the nearest key square of the pawn of {0} on ({1} {2})
glosses.king_in_front: the opposing king stands right in front of the pawn of {0} on ({1} {2})
glosses.edge_gap_file: the file {0} is {1} steps from the nearest edge of the board
glosses.edge_gap_rank: the rank {0} is {1} steps from the nearest edge of the board
glosses.goal_gap_rank: the rank {1} is {2} steps from the rank where {0} promotes

note: The key-square vocabulary of chess (plan 78.32): the relational vocabulary (vocabulary.relational.json) plus the key squares of a pawn (rules/concepts/chess_keys.gdl): how far each king is from the nearest key square of a pawn, and the defending king standing right in front of it. The words were proposed by hand when induction went in circles; a rule written with them is admitted only by the exact drill.
